artwork.prompt: Playlist cover artwork, square format, evocative rather than literal. A 2026 cover deliberately styled after 1955-1979. Medium: modernist graphic design in flat cut-paper shapes. Not a depiction — an abstract composition that only distantly evokes a thin horizon line on cream. Palette: sand, sea green, sun yellow, white. Composition: strict grid, large flat colour fields. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
